cond_0001.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing and performing electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
Knowledge – Skills – Abilities
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in a scientific field
3 Years of experience
Preferred Requirements
Prior progressive experience in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging

cond_0012.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing and performing electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0012.responsibilities: Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
cond_0012.requirements:
PhD in a scientific field, or equivalent practical experience in a relevant discipline.
Around 3 years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training.
Prior experience with electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging is a plus; candidates still building this background are welcome to apply.
Working knowledge of biology, chemistry, and mathematics.
Familiarity with documentation and records management practices.
Ability to work through complex problems and think critically; openness to developing these skills further on the job.
Comfort with data utilization and resource management.
Willingness to communicate findings clearly in writing and to collaborate with scientists and clinicians.

The role also involves management and maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility, training in the efficient use of microscopes and ancillary equipment, and instrumentation for sample preparation. This individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0034.responsibilities:
Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advising clients and users on the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals.
Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This includes but is not limited to preparing and examining specimens by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining, negative staining, high pressure freezing, freeze substitution, immune-electron microscopy, and viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope.
Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems, and assure instrument integrity by arranging scheduled maintenance service.
Document accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and flag atypical or abnormal findings requiring additional follow up.
Coordinate with scientists and clinicians to improve final reporting and diagnosis based on findings.
Oversee quality control, confirm instrumentation is functioning within defined tolerance limits, and ensure documentation is complete.
Perform CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols.
Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-annual CAP inspection readiness.
Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests.
Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records, and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure documentation, and quality controls.
Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients.
Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; maintain laboratory organization; handle scientific requests from clients.
Train new employees, students, and other health Facility clients on relevant equipment and procedures.
cond_0034.requirements:
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills.
PhD in a scientific field
3 Years of experience
Prior progressive experience in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging preferred

This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0065.responsibilities: Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
cond_0065.requirements:
Advanced knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Deep expertise in data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing.
PhD in a scientific field required; advanced degree or postdoctoral experience strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant scientific role.
Substantial prior progressive experience in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging required; candidates with deep, hands-on expertise in these techniques are strongly preferred.

cond_0076.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing and performing electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of electron microscopy techniques and sample preparation work.
cond_0076.responsibilities: Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
cond_0076.requirements:

Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.

cond_0219.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing and performing electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0219.responsibilities:
Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
Knowledge – Skills – Abilities
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills.
cond_0219.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in a scientific field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 3 years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training
Preferred Requirements
Some background in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging is a plus; candidates still building experience in this area are welcome to apply

cond_0252.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing, and electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. The role also involves shared responsibility for management and maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. We expect the person in this role to work alongside the team in the efficient use of microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation, and to contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods and the organization of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0252.responsibilities:
Coordinate with clients and users to advise on the best options for their electron microscopy work to help them achieve their desired goals, drawing on knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques.
Work with the team to process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation, including but not limited to semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining, negative staining, high pressure freezing, freeze substitution, immune-electron microscopy, and viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope.
Coordinate maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems, and help ensure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service.
Share responsibility for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and flagging atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up.
Work with scientists and clinicians to build shared knowledge of findings and improve final reporting and diagnosis.
Help ensure quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits, and documentation is complete.
Perform CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols in coordination with the team.
Support the Facility's compliance with CAP regulations and assist with bi-annual CAP inspection readiness.
Prepare solutions and chemicals as required to fulfill research requests.
Assist in maintaining image databases, clear records, and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedures, and quality controls.
Help ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients.
Coordinate ordering of supplies; support lab safety and laboratory organization; work with clients on scientific requests.
Teach, train, and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
cond_0252.requirements:
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills.
PhD in a scientific field
3 Years of experience
Prior progressive experience in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging preferred

cond_0272.intro: This position centers on sample preparation, processing and performing electron microscopy on samples for research projects across the [Company name masked] Campus. This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0272.responsibilities: Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
cond_0272.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in a scientific field required; advanced degree strongly preferred
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in a relevant scientific discipline
Advanced knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management
Exceptional critical thinking, complex problem solving, and resource management abilities
Strong command of data utilization and scientific writing
Preferred Requirements
Proven track record in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging, with substantial progressive experience in the field

Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients.

Teach, train, and mentor new employees, students, and other facility clients.

Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.

This position also entails responsibility for management, maintenance of hardware within the Core Facility. This position holds expectation to train in the efficient use of the microscopes and ancillary equipment, as well as instrumentation for sample preparation. The expectation is that this individual would contribute to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation, and would participate in the organization and maintenance of the Core Facility infrastructure.
cond_0471.responsibilities:
Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. This will permit advise of clients and users regarding the best options for their electron microscopy work to achieve their desired goals. Process tissue and other samples by a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This should include but not be limited to prepare and examine specimen by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining; negative staining; high pressure freezing; freeze substitution; immune-electron microscopy; viewing and recording digital images of specimens in the electron microscope. Oversee maintenance and care of the microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems and assure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service. Responsible for reporting accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and for recognition of atypical/abnormal findings requiring additional follow up. Works with scientists and clinicians to increase knowledge of findings to improve upon final reporting and diagnosis. Oversee ensuring quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning and maintained within defined tolerance limits and documentation is complete. Performs CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations for bi-Annual CAP inspection readiness. Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for the fulfillment of research requests. Oversee the maintenance of image databases, clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedure and quality controls. Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients. Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety; laboratory organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients. Teach, train and/or mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.
Knowledge – Skills – Abilities
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management. Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills.
cond_0471.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in a scientific field, or equivalent practical experience
Around 3 years of experience, or an equivalent combination of education and training
Preferred Requirements
Some background in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging is a plus; candidates still building experience in this area are welcome to apply

The role also involves managing and maintaining hardware within the Core Facility, training users on microscopes and ancillary equipment, and contributing to the implementation of new experimental methods in microscopy and sample preparation. You will regularly work with scientists, clinicians, and facility clients as a central part of the day-to-day work.
cond_0492.responsibilities:
Possess knowledge and expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques. You will regularly advise clients and users on the best options for their electron microscopy work to help them reach their goals.
Process tissue and other samples using a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation. This includes but is not limited to preparing and examining specimens by semi-thin and ultrathin-sectioning, section staining, negative staining, high pressure freezing, freeze substitution, immune-electron microscopy, and viewing and recording digital images in the electron microscope.
Oversee maintenance and care of microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems, and ensure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service.
Report accurate findings, including evaluating findings for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and recognizing atypical or abnormal findings that require additional follow-up. Work closely and regularly with scientists and clinicians to improve final reporting and diagnosis.
Oversee quality control, ensure instrumentation is functioning within defined tolerance limits, and keep documentation complete.
Perform CLIA level validation of new procedures and protocols. Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations and is ready for bi-annual CAP inspection.
Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for research requests.
Oversee maintenance of image databases, clear records, and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedures, and quality controls.
Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients.
Oversee ordering of supplies; ensure lab safety and organization; coordinate scientific requests from clients, staying in regular contact to clarify needs and communicate progress.
Teach, train, and mentor new employees, students, and other facility clients.
cond_0492.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
PhD in a scientific field
3 Years of experience
Knowledge of biology, chemistry, mathematics, documentation, and records management
Data utilization, complex problem solving, critical thinking, resource management, and writing skills
Preferred Requirements
Prior progressive experience in electron microscopy and high-resolution imaging

Apply expertise in electron and high-resolution imaging techniques to advise clients and users on the best options for their electron microscopy work.
Process tissue and other samples using a wide range of techniques and prepare specimens for microscopic observation, including semi-thin and ultrathin sectioning, section staining, negative staining, high pressure freezing, freeze substitution, immune-electron microscopy, and recording digital images.
Direct maintenance and care of microscopes and associated equipment, troubleshoot problems, and ensure instrument integrity by arranging regular maintenance service.
Deliver accurate findings, evaluate results for scientific and clinical significance and validity, and identify atypical or abnormal findings requiring follow-up.
Engage with scientists and clinicians to deepen understanding of findings and improve final reporting and diagnosis.
Ensure quality control is acceptable, instrumentation is functioning within defined tolerance limits, and documentation is complete.
Execute CLIA-level validation of new procedures and protocols.
Ensure the Facility complies with CAP regulations and maintains bi-annual CAP inspection readiness.
Prepare solutions and chemicals as required for research requests.
Manage image databases, maintain clear records and exact locations of specimens, image files, reports, procedures, and quality controls.
Ensure correct and timely billing for EM services to all clients.
Oversee supply ordering, lab safety, and laboratory organization; manage scientific requests from clients.
Teach, train, and mentor new employees, students, and other health Facility clients.

PhD in a scientific field
3 Years of experience
